_comment: V4.5/V4.6.1 egg task settings (read-only at runtime; edit with a text editor, then restart the task).
_carton_grid: V4.6.6 fixed carton layout [rows, cols]: rows = along the 2-hole direction, cols = along the 3-hole direction (measured 2026-11-08: 2x3). null = guess from the outer box (V3.49, unreliable)
_slot_pitch_mm: measured centre-to-centre slot pitch [along the cols (3-hole direction), along the rows (2-hole direction)] in mm (measured 2026-11-08: 46 / 47); null = derive from the outer box + cavities
_held_gap_mm: SO-101 tip-gap reading (gripper gap_mm) when an egg is clamped properly; measured 26.5 mm on 2026-11-07 (3 grasps: 26.7 / 26.5 / 26.5)
_offcentre_margin_mm: a clamped reading this much below held_gap_mm counts as an off-centre grasp
_offcentre_regrasp: false = only log an off-centre grasp and carry on (default); true = release, look again and regrasp once
_wrist_slot_look_before_pick: true = before the pick, look at the target slot with the wrist camera (empty gripper); off until verified
_wrist_gripper_mask: wrist-image region hidden by the gripper jaws (normalised x, y polygon); excluded from wrist detection
_wrist_overexposed_frac: wrist detection is 'unusable' when more than this fraction of the search area is nearly white (>= wrist_overexposed_level)
